notes.title: Mr.President!'s Day Update - Trading Cards - Rump Rumble
notes.notes:
https://giant.gfycat.com/NegativeAmpleDobermanpinscher.gif

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26464872/9aa113b40558228be7f99060713cbc5f41f6d977.jpg

Let’s get ready to RUUUUUMP RUUUMBLE

Rump will not be stopped. Travel bans were just not enough to keep this country safe. So Rump has taken the reigns with his tiny hands and has decided to kick out all of the immigrants himself. To illustrate this point to all “Non Believers”, he has set up the Rump Rumble to showcase his power and majesty to over power these hidden threats. Get into the ring and toss out all that oppose you to progress through this totally not rigged championship. Without the power of Dick “Rock-Hard” Johnson, Can you keep this country safe? 

-How to play the Rump Rumble-
--Make sure to finish Chapter One of the main campaign. (It is your only option when starting the game.)
--Look for the Rump Rumble poster on the left wall next to the priceless portrait of Mr.Rump 
--Tips: Use your arsenal moves to get rid of the invading horde. Backflipping is your friend. Why not try [Capslock] ? With the help of big Oil Money investors we have bought up most of the real estate of your keyboard on super fancy efficient moves, so use it!


Trading Cards
With this update also introduces Trading Cards for the first time for Mr.President! 

-5 Cards to Collect
-6 Tiers of Badges to Unlock 
-4 Background to Unlock 
-9 Emoticons to Unlock

-Hugs and Kisses Game Developer X-
